ABOUT ME :)


Kevin Martínez🧟

Sixth-semester Economics student at Universidad Santiago de Cali. Interested in economic research and in how data can be used to understand real-world problems. Still exploring rather than committing to a single field.


(If you would like to get in touch with me, feel free to send me an email. Please use “Blog” as the subject line. Any advice, respectful criticism, curiosity, or request for more information about me is welcome!!!!.)

title: Understanding economics through data.
text:
DATA · ECONOMICS · RESEARCH



ECONOMICS · DATA · RESEARCH


Understanding economics through data.


Hey it’s a pleasure, I’m Kevin, an Economics student interested in research, data, and applied economics.
I use this website to document what I learn and the projects I work on throughout my studies. Here you will find economic analyses, data visualizations, essays, and research projects covering a variety of topics.
I am still exploring where my interests in economics will take me, so I am keeping an open mind and learning by doing.
Explore my work, or learn more about me. 🕵️‍♂️

 About me ↗

“If I have seen further it is by standing on the shoulders of Giants.⛰️”

For this idea, among others, I want to learn and do research to help people and apply what I learn to solve problems that require deep reflection. I want to think more about what numbers represent rather than simply looking at figures, because we are limited human beings trying to understand more about this uncertain world, while recognizing that the ideas I work with do not entirely belong to me.
